title: Untitled
medium: Hand cut and high temperature painted ceramic

said.q: In this untitled work from 2011, Dávila takes on Josef Albers Homage to the Square series (made from 1949-1976) where Albers explored the complex nature of perception and color interactions. Dávila’s work is made of cut and stacked ceramic tile, posing questions about the hierarchical relationship between paint and ceramics, canvas and tile, and artist and construction worker.
